headline: ARI @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.96 at STL 4.38, with a projected total of 9.34. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved +0.71 runs while STL moved +0.08, changing the projected margin by +0.63 runs. The projected total climbed +0.79, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Matthew Liberatore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Ketel Marte, Gabriel Moreno, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
